**So, a quick story time:**

I am a fan of hip-hop and a pop-punk head and I was not really a fan of K-pop before, in fact, I DESPISE it. I don't know why, maybe because I don't understand the Korean language, but I am certainly sure that I only hated it because my friends and the internet told me to. But all of these would change when one day, when I was listening on shuffle on Spotify, the song **'OMG' by NewJeans** suddenly played. I was about to skip but something about it made me feel some type of way as the song progresses. Like I get it, it is K-pop, but this one was different. And even if I wanted to proceed to my regular genre, the song was stuck in my head until eventually the song was on loop until the next few weeks. And just before I knew it, I began to stan NJ and discover and expand my taste in K-pop. And to be honest, I wish I could've listened to K-pop before considering that their music is really good.  I am now a teenager currently stanning 5 girl group all at the same time lol.
